limitations: Policy conformance under illustrative operator assumptions is not incident truth, mitigation necessity or operational safety.
Constructed variants, overlapping source panels and repeated calls are not independent safety trials; no safety-probability confidence interval is inferred.
The census contains only eligible Benign/ICMPFlood/SYNFlood/UDPFlood records; unsupported labels and zero/undefined attack packet rates remain excluded.
All control identities, slices, authorities and state are simulated. No learned detector, LLM planner, live E2/A1 integration or radio service outcome is validated.
Natural proposals and controlled violations remain separate. Zero required-block denominators are null, not successful blocking evidence.
False-alarm admissions remain a limitation group, not safe-action successes. Audit checksums are not signatures or evidence authentication.
Timing is local host/workload evidence. Buffered event logging is not durable persistence; there is no hard-real-time or production-capacity claim.
Process-block percentile means are not pooled request percentiles; paired differences of percentiles are not percentiles of per-request overhead.
Load latency percentiles describe completed requests only. Overflow and right-censored requests remain in all-offered denominators; generator-limited conditions are retained.
This report hashes and checks compact summaries/receipts only. It does not reread or independently recompute raw CSV/JSONL observations.

performance.timing_interpretation: Means/min/max of process-block percentiles, not pooled request percentiles. Existing paired bootstrap intervals are copied without recomputation.

natural_panel_analysis.note: No confidence intervals: panels overlap and outcomes are reused from the census. Primary release weighting is the ratio of poststratified numerator and denominator fractions. Macro and population-weighted means of class-conditional rates are separately labeled descriptive quantities, not the release-wide conditional rate.

netslab.interpretation: Constructed policy-conformance coverage, not independent safety trials or operational assurance.

sampling_protocol.independence: overlapping panels; no independent-trial confidence intervals
sampling_protocol.row_encoding: UTF-8 json.dumps(header-ordered original cell strings excluding blank and Unnamed: headers, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(',', ':'))
sampling_protocol.row_identity: SHA256(row_encoding); first occurrence retained before numeric eligibility checks
sampling_protocol.seed_key: ASCII 5gnidd-keyed-rank/1 followed by NUL followed by unsigned 4-byte big-endian seed

interaction_coverage.coverage_scope: declared binary factor partitions, not exhaustive engine input space

validity.interpretation: Constructed policy-conformance coverage, not independent safety trials or operational assurance.

legacy_reference_audit.scope: Original frozen 120 cases, independently reinterpreted; not new source observations

scoped_properties.scope: scoped properties on six valid action witnesses; not universal proofs

test_sensitivity.scope: 14 predeclared test-only targeted mutations; not exhaustive fault coverage

verification_scope: Compact JSON/protocol bytes and recorded provenance only; raw observations not reread or independently reverified.
